definitions.explanation: Every level, layer, or stratum of society, an organization, or a structure. Often used to describe the breadth of something that spans all segments.

examples.japanese: {社会|しゃかい}の{各層|かくそう}から{意見|いけん}を{集|あつ}めた。
examples.english: We gathered opinions from all levels of society.

examples.japanese: {各層|かくそう}の{市民|しみん}が{参加|さんか}した。
examples.english: Citizens from all walks of life participated.

examples.japanese: このイベントは{年齢|ねんれい}・{性別|せいべつ}を{問|と}わず{各層|かくそう}に{支持|しじ}されている。
examples.english: This event is supported by people of all demographics regardless of age or gender.

notes:
USAGE:
Often appears in formal or written contexts, especially in news articles and official reports. Commonly paired with {社会|しゃかい} (society) to describe "all levels of society."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社会|しゃかい}の{各層|かくそう} (all levels of society)
- {各層|かくそう}にわたる (spanning all levels)
- {各層|かくそう}から{支持|しじ}される (supported by all levels)
